thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> PD: HIGH_RATE_LIMITER_ERRORS (pager=page)
incident-bot: service=rate-limiter, symptom=unexpected_429_burst, affected_tenant=acme-co, window=60s, spike=620% :rotating_light:

alex: acked on PD :thumbsup:

priya: i'm taking this. quick context?

jamal: seeing lots of `quota_mapper: nil response for tenant_id` in limiter logs starting ~03:12 UTC. Throttles line up w/ that, not upstream 5xxs.

melissa: @priya can you confirm if this is the new quota rollout? we shipped the quota-mapper change last night to enable per-tenant burst allowances.

priya: checking deploys... looking at deploys-service, yes quota-mapper v2 rolled at 01:45 UTC. conf looks fine in staging.

opsbot: Headline metrics -> limiter_error_rate: 0.42 -> 4.1 in 5m for acme-co, request_rate unchanged. Cache miss spike on quota cache.

jamal: dumping recent logs:

```
2026-03-14T03:12:15Z limiter ERROR quota_mapper.go:87 "nil mapping returned" tenant=acme-co
2026-03-14T03:12:15Z limiter WARN  handler.go:243 "apply strict policy failed, falling back" tenant=acme-co
```

sara: PD shows auto-escalation to oncall-sre after 2mins (unacked). alex, you acked, but PD escalated before we had triage.

alex: i acked ASAP but PD timing overlapped. i'll tidy PD escalations later.

priya: root cause hypothesis: quota-mapper returning null triggers a strict default that enforces zero-burst -> immediate throttles. Need to either (A) patch quota-mapper to return default burst for missing entries or (B) toggle limiter to soft-fail to allow requests while mapper recovers.

melissa: for immediate mitigation i'd prefer soft-fail toggle (B). lower blast radius.

jamal: agree. i'll apply soft-fail flag to limiter config for acme-co and global fallback for 10min.

priya: do it and announce here. also add a temporary metric for `quota_mapper_nil_count` for postmortem.

jamal: executing:

```
# temp soft-fail for acme-co
POST https://config-service.internal/v1/tenants/acme-co/overrides
{"limiter": {"strict_quota_enforcement": false, "override_expires": "2026-03-14T03:40:00Z"}}
```

opsbot: config service responded 200. rolling update to limiter pods (3 pods): `kubectl rollout restart deployment/rate-limiter -n infra`.

melissa: can we confirm error rate down on dashboards?

opsbot: within 45s of restart, limiter_error_rate for acme-co dropped from 4.1 -> 0.18. 429s went to near-zero.

sara: customer impact: logs show client retries but only minor visible failures. Support ticket spike: 6 customers reported intermittent 429s; only acme-co had larger rate of hits. No loss of data.

alex: good. escalations: PD -> acknowledged then auto-escalated due to duplicate ack timing. we should update PD escalation timing and add an incident label.

priya: action items during mitigation:
- add `quota_mapper_nil_count` metric (jamal)
- revert quota-mapper deploy to last-known-good if we see recurrence (melissa)
- audit rollout pipeline for quota mappings (sre)
- postmortem board will include timeline and customer impact notes (priya)

jamal: note: logs also show occasional Redis timeouts causing mapper nil responses. opening ticket with infra for Redis cluster health.

melissa: i'll open a rollback PR as precaution but won't merge until we confirm root cause.

priya: setting PD note: "soft-fail applied, monitoring. impact reduced." tagging support and account execs for acme.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Note added to incident. Incident status: acknowledged. Escalation paused.

sara: i've messaged acme-co CSM with short summary and ETA for follow-up postmortem. no SLA breach expected but flagging for transparency.

opsbot: summary metrics at 03:25 UTC -> limiter_error_rate delta -96%, 429s -> 1/min total, request latency stable.

alex: nice work. keep this thread updated. once we confirm stability for 30m we can re-enable strict enforcement and roll quota-mapper forward with additional checks.

priya: leaving on-call watch for 30m. jamal, please file infra ticket for Redis and link here.

jamal: ticket INF-8721 created: "redis: intermittent timeouts affecting quota-mapper" - link: https://tickets.internal/INF-8721

melissa: post-incident tasks created in /incidents/2276543210 -> action items assigned.

priya: last check at 03:38 UTC: stable. switching to monitoring-only and closing PD alert if no recurrence.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident resolved (auto-close after 1h inactivity) :white_check_mark:

alex: postmortem owners: priya (lead), jamal (svc logs/metrics), melissa (deploy/rollback), sara (customer comms). I'll draft and circulate.

sara: adding customer impact summary to ticket and CSM notes.

melissa: note for postmortem — add a unit/integration test around quota-mapper nil handling; it should never cause hard-enforcement by default.

priya: will include timeline and the mitigation timestamp. thanks team :planet:
